items.t: Critical Metals Rises 3% as Rare Earth Stocks Extend Rally; USA Rare Earth Climbs 3%, MP Materials Gains 2%
items.sum: While small caps and materials stocks slide, rare earth names are surging, and one Greenland-focused developer has lagged the pack all year. Can it close the gap, or does a going-concern warning keep it grounded?

items.t: MP's Q3 Revenues Jump 176%: Can This Growth Be Sustained?
items.sum: MP Materials' third-quarter revenues surge 176% as higher NdPr prices, increased sales volumes and heavy rare earth sales fueled growth.

items.t: Wall Street Wrap: Nvidia Faces Downgrades As Jensen Huang’s Exit Rattles Analysts — AMD, MP Materials, Riot Platforms Get Bullish Calls
items.sum: Wall Street firms cut Nvidia’s rating citing Jensen Huang’s departure while rival AMD drew upgrades.

items.t: MP Materials Stock Rises After Insiders Buy $3.35 Million
items.sum: The purchases came after MP began saleable magnet shipments to General Motors

items.t: MP Materials Gains 3% as Traders Pick Winners Among Critical-Minerals Stocks; United States Antimony Slides 6%, Critical Metals Drops 5%
items.sum: While speculative rare earths names bleed on a risk-off Thursday, one producer keeps climbing. What separates the stock traders are buying from the ones they are dumping, and how much of its strength rests on a single one-time sale?

items.t: MP Materials sees flurry of insider purchases as shares underperform YTD
items.sum: Investing.com -- MP Materials Corp (NYSE:MP) shares gained in pre-open trading Thursday after three insiders have disclosed more than $3.35 million in combined stock purchases, potentially signaling confidence in the rare-earth producer following a difficult year for its shares.
